observations.behavior: Adds nullable support and documentation for GitHub installation linking, including orphan installations and personal account status.
observations.code_quote: * A project in the organization that already has this installation linked. Null when the installation isn't linked to any project yet — it was found via the user's personal GitHub link and can be adopted by linking it here.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the GitHub integration to distinguish between established organization installations and orphan installations found via a user's personal GitHub account, enabling adoption of the latter. This supports the workflow where a user with a personal GitHub account can adopt an existing GitHub App installation not yet linked to their PostHog project.
